attrs.lead: A simple, transparent process, so you always know what’s happening, what’s next and what we need from you.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.text: A free 30-minute call. We learn about your business, your goals, your budget and what you’ve already tried, and tell you honestly whether we’re the right fit.
get: A short written summary of the call

steps.title: Audit
steps.text: We look under the hood: your website, search rankings, AI visibility, ads, analytics and your top competitors. Every issue is ranked by how much it’s costing you.

steps.text: We turn the audit into a plan: what we’ll do, in what order, and why. We agree the targets together, so we both know what success looks like.
get: Agreed targets and how we’ll measure them
A fixed monthly fee, no surprises
need: Review the plan and sign it off

steps.text: You meet your team and your single point of contact. We set up a shared workspace and fix tracking first, so every result from here on is measured properly.
need: One person on your side we can talk to

steps.title: Build and launch
steps.text: Marketing and development work side by side: pages, content, campaigns and fixes go live in planned sprints. You see everything before it launches.
get: Review rounds before anything goes live
A launch checklist, signed off together

steps.title: Measure and improve
steps.text: A plain-English report tied to enquiries and sales, and a call to walk you through it. We test, learn and refresh the plan every quarter.

attrs.title: Questions, answered
attrs.lead: Can’t find your answer? Ask us on a free 30-minute call.

items.question: Can I hire you for just one service?
items.answer: Yes. Many clients start with one service, such as SEO or a new website, and add more later. You only pay for what you need.

items.question: Which service should I start with?
items.answer: It depends on your goals and where you are today. If you’re not sure, start with a free call or an audit and we’ll recommend the first steps.

items.question: How much do your services cost?
items.answer: It depends on what you need. After a free discovery call we send a fixed quote for projects, or a clear monthly fee for ongoing marketing.

items.question: Do marketing and development really work as one team?
items.answer: Yes. Our marketers and developers plan together and share the same goals, so changes like new landing pages or speed fixes don’t get stuck between suppliers.

attrs.title: Not sure what you need? Let’s talk.
attrs.lead: Tell us where you want to be in a year. We’ll recommend the right mix of services on a free 30-minute call.
